resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Cass County list gives 1952 or 1954 for the move; the Morrison County list gives 1954. The story reports both and cites each.
The Cass County table type column says Ladder while its note calls the tower an 81 foot stairway tower. The story gives no type.

notes_for_editor: Only three sources, none describing the site after removal. Cass list type column says Ladder, note says stairway. Move year conflict (1952 vs 1954) is reported in the story. Coordinates in the record (46.36571, -94.60013) were not checked against the site; Motley itself spans Morrison and Cass counties. No staffing or fire history found in the sources read.
